horoscopes.intro: October 30 in the stars: Find out what’s in store for you today in our daily horoscopes for Friday October 30. Read the daily horoscopes for your Sun sign or rising sign (ascendant) to plan your day.

aries.text: Reread that message before you assume the worst, Aries. Hot-blooded Mars in Leo squares off with retrograde Mercury in Scorpio today, and a misunderstanding could blow up faster than you’d expect. You could easily read a slight into a text that wasn’t there, or fire off a reply you’ll wish you could delete an hour later. Restrain yourself, or walk out of the room when you feel your temper heating up. The aftermath of any such meltdowns won’t be fun to clean up.

taurus.text: Your thinking may scatter in every direction today, Taurus, so don’t rush to make any important decisions and don’t let anyone pressure you into saying yes (or no) before you’re fully informed. With Mercury retrograde squaring hot-blooded Mars, second-guessing comes with the territory. Although this day can bring some ups and downs, be mindful of the impact your sharp words can have on the ones you love. You don’t want to snap at someone who’s only trying to lend support.

gemini.text: There’s nothing wrong with aiming for the best, Gemini, but have you set the bar so high that no one, yourself included, can reach it? Under today’s Mars-Mercury dust-up, with your ruler in reverse, you’d be wise to dial down the perfectionism. Instead, try to find beauty in the so-called flaws and humor in the moments of surprise. Rewind and be kind—to yourself first. Then it will be easier to extend the same generosity to everyone else.

cancer.text: A little retail therapy can lift your spirits, Cancer, but under today’s unrestrained square between Mars in your fiery second house and retrograde Mercury, impulse purchases can put you in the red. Get a firm grip on what your budget REALLY allows. If you’ve got your sights set on a high-end item, set up a savings account earmarked for it or look for a zero-interest payment plan. With Mercury backing up, double-check the return policy before you commit to anything.

leo.text: Tame your reactive instincts today. As hotheaded Mars in your self-authorized first house clashes with retrograde Mercury, you could fire back before you’ve fully understood what someone actually meant. Preserve some fight in you, Leo, but aim it carefully. You don’t have to unleash a ferocious roar over a message that reads differently than it was written. Ask what they meant before you decide you’ve been insulted.

virgo.text: Beware the smooth-talking salesperson, Virgo, and stay wary when someone’s pitch sounds a little too slick. With aggressive Mars in a tangled angle to your ruler, Mercury, now retrograde, you could unwittingly fall for a hustler’s hype. Maybe people are the genuine article, or maybe you’re being duped. Today, it’s just too hard to tell. Assume nothing until you have facts and figures in front of you.

libra.text: Before you dive deeper into that collaboration, make sure everything you’re pooling gets shared and distributed equally. Retrograde Mercury squares fiery Mars today, and a miscommunication could become a source of friction among your friend group or team. You’re as generous as they come, Libra, but when something feels unfair, your internal alarm starts clanging. Ask for transparency around group spending and get the division of labor in writing.

scorpio.text: You have a vision, Scorpio, and a genius one at that. But under today’s befuddling Mars-Mercury square, with the messenger planet backing through your sign, you could struggle to convince others of its merits. People may demand practical proof before signing on or need more time to mull things over. Try to imagine what their objections may be, then find ways to address each one. Will it be profitable, enjoyable, a smart use of time? If you’re ready with answers, their critiques can become an opening for dialogue.

sagittarius.text: Seek and ye shall find, Sagittarius, as long as you’re not searching through rose-colored lenses. Under today’s Mars-Mercury square, with the messenger planet in reverse, you could fall into the trap of hearing what you want to hear and skipping the unpleasant details. But this is a recipe for future disappointment. Ask the follow-up question even when you’re fairly sure you won’t love the answer. Better to know now than to be blindsided next month.

capricorn.text: Forget about keeping up with the influencers today, Capricorn. Just keep it real. Your teammates don’t need to see a brave front right now; they want to know how you’re REALLY doing. How else can they support you AND collaborate effectively? If you’ve been keeping important intel close to your vest, call a squad summit and let everyone in on it. Just repeat the key points twice, since Mercury in reverse has a way of scrambling the message in transit.

aquarius.text: Mixing business with pleasure is rarely a good idea, and under today’s disruptive Mars-Mercury square, with the messenger planet retrograde, blurred lines could spell disaster. If you need a partner on a professional project, write up a proper job description and circulate it among industry contacts rather than asking a friend who doesn’t have the right skill set. Keep your relationships sacred, at work and at home, by keeping everyone in their appropriate lane.

pisces.text: Accessorizing is practically your love language, Pisces. But with scrappy Mars in your sixth house of systems squaring Mercury retrograde in your ninth, all that ornamentation could run away with your whole day. You’ll want to choose the perfect ribbon before the gift has even been bought. Handle the dull-but-necessary items first, and THEN let yourself embellish and gold-leaf to your heart’s content. And if someone takes issue with your methods today, let them finish the sentence before you mount your defense.
